title: Run
description: Harness record for one execution of a task. phase, injection_plan, and fix_kinds live here and must not be stored on a Trace. A Run links to the Trace documents it produced via trace_ids. The runner, injector, and fix applicator are out of scope for this schema; this file only freezes their contract.

parent_run_id.description: Run this one replays, when phase is after_fix. Null or omitted otherwise. Not a Trace field.

phase.description: baseline: no injected fault and no fix. injected: injection_plan is set and fix_kinds is empty. after_fix: at least one FixKind is applied; injection_plan may repeat the original fault or be null for a clean replay.

trace_ids.description: Traces produced or compared by this run. Empty while the run has not written a trace yet.

injection_plan.description: Null unless a fault is part of this run. The plan is the injector's intent; the resulting labels are copied onto Trace.fault by the injector, not by Grok.

fix_kinds.description: FixKind values applied to this run. Empty unless phase is after_fix. This is the harness applied-fix list.

error_message.description: Present when status is error, or when the harness wants to record a non-fatal note. Optional.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the run once it leaves the queue. Optional while queued.

prompt.description: Effective task prompt for this run (prompt_override or task.prompt) before any attached juror/order note. Optional. Absent on runs saved before contract 0.6.0. Not a Trace field.

faultCategory.description: Same closed set as Trace.fault.labels[].category and Diagnosis.category.

fixKind.description: controlled_retry, pre_response_check, and permission_guard. These are harness fix kinds, not Trace fields.

fault.description: What the injector changes, in one sentence.

target.description: Tool name or other harness target the fault aims at.

at_step.description: Optional 0-based step index where the fault is applied.

ground_truth.description: Label the injector will write onto Trace.fault. Eval reads this; Grok does not, in the online demo.

step_id.description: Known once the target step exists. Omit if the injector assigns it at runtime.
